## What's new
- **Service icons on cards** – every service card now shows a large, faded icon of its service in the background (Overview, Downloads, History and Requests)
  - ArrHub fetches the **official icon from your own instance** of Radarr, Sonarr, qBittorrent, NZBGet and Seerr – it tries the service's known icon paths, then the icon declared on its start page
  - if an icon can't be fetched, a **generic icon** in the service colour is shown instead
  - new controls in **Settings → Appearance**: on/off switch, **strength** slider (3–30 %), *Reload icons* button and a per-service status (official / generic icon)
  - icon size follows the card height, so short and narrow cards (and mobile) stay readable
  - icons are cached for 24 h and served with a strict `Content-Security-Policy` and `nosniff`
- New environment variables: `ARRHUB_CARD_ICONS`, `ARRHUB_CARD_ICON_STRENGTH`
- English and Croatian translations for all of the above

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.2.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept; card icons are on by default and can be turned off in Settings → Appearance.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0
